protocol.decision: Do not promote C unless its pair-level conservative 95% lower bound exceeds 0.5 against B at BOTH budgets, with at least 32 completed pairs per condition. Treat multiple comparisons as exploratory; independent confirmation and Mac acceptance still required.

timedIntervalMethod: Hoeffding; also uniform over all 32 possible prefix counts and six comparisons at familywise alpha 0.05. Assumes representative independent opening-pair samples; host drift remains a limitation.
